$schema: SafeWeb default trigger-word categories. Words are scanned (case/obfuscation-insensitive) in URLs, search queries, and — when enabled — visible page text.
note: A deliberately conservative default set. Accountability partners can add, remove, or disable whole categories from the dashboard. Whole-word matching plus obfuscation folding is applied by shared/matcher.js. Keep terms lowercase; severity is one of info|low|medium|high.

explicit.description: Sexually explicit terms strongly associated with adult content.

search-intent.description: Phrases that indicate an intent to seek out adult material.

self-harm.description: Optional safety category — surfaces crisis-related searches so a parent can reach out. Off by default; enable with care.
